lines.speaker: Tower Keeper
lines.text: Halt, traveller. I am the keeper of this abandoned tower. None pass these halls without my leave.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: The enemy king has taken my brother. This tower lies on his trail. I must get through.

lines.speaker: Tower Keeper
lines.text: Your crown means nothing here, Princess. Turn back. You shall not pass!

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Then you leave me no choice. Stand aside, or face me.
